GoldArmor AI

GoldArmor EA monitors XAUUSD price structure across timeframes. After a breakout, momentum informs entry and volatility and open positions guide the exit.

FX · MULTI-PAIR STRATEGY↗

Surfer

Surfer EA trades four USD currency pairs as a portfolio. It trails profits during sustained moves and can lock positions in extreme trends. The combined USD exposure matters across all four pairs.

Reported daily volumeAbout 100 lots / day
Surfer strategy familyExplore →
GOLD · BASIS STRATEGY↗

GoldOwl

GoldOwl tracks the difference between gold futures and spot prices, known as the basis. When it detects a divergence, it takes opposing positions. The result depends on convergence and the cost of both legs.

Reported daily trade count2–20 trades / day
